paite: Hiai thilte nung a ka etleh, ngai in, van ah kongkhak akihong a; ka aw zak masakpen pengkul aw ging bang in kei ahon houpih hi, "Hiai ah hong paitou in, huan tunung chiang a thil hong om dingte ka hon musak ding," achi hi.
heading: Van Muhna
english: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven, and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”

paite: Thakhat in Kha in ka om pah ngal a; ngai in, van ah laltutphah ahong kitungta a, laltutphah tung ah mi khat atu hi.
english: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne

paite: Huai mi jasper leh karnelia suang bang in akimu a; huai laltutphah kimvel ah sakhituihup, emerald suang bang mai a kimu in azam hi.
english: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

paite: Huan huai laltutphah kimvel ah laltutphah dang sawmnih-le-li a-om a; huai laltutphahte tung ah upa sawmnih-le-li, puanngou a kizem a tu ka mu a, amaute'n dangka-eng lallukhu akhu chiat uhi.
english: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

paite: Huai laltutphah a kipan in khophiate, awte leh vanpigingte ahong suakkhia hi. Huan mei khawnvak sagih, laltutphah ma ah akuang a, huaite Pathian Kha sagihte ahi uhi.
english: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

paite: Huai laltutphah ma ah kristal bang a siang limlang tuipi a-om hi. Huai laltutphah kimvel ah thil hing nunglam leh malam mit a dim a-om uhi.
english: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the midst of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

paite: Thil hing khatna humpinelkai bang ahi a, thil hing nihna bawngnou bang ahi a, thil hing thumna in mihing mai bang anei hi, thil hing lina muvanlai leng lai bang ahi.
english: The first creature was like a lion, and the second creature like a calf, and the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

paite: Huai thil hing lite'n kha guk anei chiat ua, akimvel leh asunglam mit ngen a dim ahi a; amaute'n sun leh zan khawl lou in: "Siangthou, Siangthou, Siangthou, Toupa Pathian, Bangkim hihthei, omsa leh omlel leh hong om ding," achi uhi.
english: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy Hodges/Farstad MT reads “holy” 9 times instead of 3. is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”

paite: Huan huai amah laltutphah tung a tupa leh huai amah tangtawn tangtawn a hingpa kiang a thil hingte'n, thupina leh zahhuaina leh kipahna thu apiak chiang un,
english: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,

paite: amah laltutphah tung a tupa ma ah upa sawmnih-le-lite abokkhup uhi, huai laltutphah ma a alallukhute uh koih in, amah tangtawn tangtawn a hingpa abia uhi.
english: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne, and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,

paite: "Nang ka Toupa leh ka Pathian uh, thupina, zahhuaina, thilhihtheihna mu tak na hi; thil tengteng nang na siam a, nang thu ziak a om leh siam ahi uhi," achi uhi.
english: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, TR omits “and God, the Holy One,” to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed, and were created!”
